notes.title: "Physical Layer"- "version 1.0f10" Update !!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Physical Layer".

We have updated the game to "version 1.0f10" from 3/20.
If you see "version 1.0f10" in the lower left corner of the title screen when you start the game, the update has been correctly applied.

The update details are as follows
-----------------------------

◆General functions.
・Fixed a problem that prevented the user from operating the options the next time he/she returns to the screen by pressing the B button after displaying the credits with the controller.
・Fixed a problem that weapon changes are not saved when returning to the title after selecting a weapon without transitioning to the next screen.
・Changed so that log files are not output.

◆Operation related.
・Added mouse sensitivity adjustment item.
・Added a tutorial that "left shift key" also activates object throw.
・Changed so that the object throw is not triggered by pressing down the left stick.

◆Volume.
・The explosion sound is no longer played continuously.
・Changed the sound of yellow cubes being destroyed to be quieter.

◆Level design.
・Weakened some of the enemies that throw kunai.
・Changed the boss in 6-4 to a single boss.
・The stage where the new gimmick first appeared has been adjusted so that the enemy does not appear.
・Extended invincibility time when hit by bullets.

-----------------------------
Thank you for your continued support of "Physical Layer".
